items.title: What is Science?
items.explanation: Science is a way of thinking, observing, and doing things to understand the world we live in and to uncover its secrets. It starts with curiosity—the desire to ask questions about our surroundings.

items.title: The Power of Curiosity
items.explanation: Curiosity drives science by encouraging us to explore tiny grains of sand, massive mountains, leaves, forests, and even the night sky. It helps us wonder why stars shine or how flowers bloom.
